description: List contact persons in weclapp. Without party_id: all contacts (/contact). With party_id: the contact persons linked to that customer/supplier (its party.contacts, read as person parties); an unknown party_id returns 0 contacts. `filters` wird als Abfrageparameter durchgereicht — weclapp filtert nach dem Muster feld-eq, feld-like, feld-gt (z. B. { "name-like": "%Muster%" }). Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_weclapp_contacts
